reviews.text:
Matt and his crew at Hard Hat Construction far exceeded our expectations!
We were on a very tight deadline to complete last-minute repairs required in order to sell our home—right in the middle of the holidays.

Every company I contacted told me it couldn’t be done in time… except Hard Hat Construction.

Matt truly makes magic happen, and made the process stress- free. From start to finish, he was incredibly responsive, communicative, and transparent. He walked us through every step of the process, clearly explaining what needed to be done and ensuring all repairs were completed and up to code.

His team was professional, efficient, and respectful of our home. The quality of work and level of service we received were outstanding!

At Hard Hat Construction they are reliable, knowledgeable, and genuinely a one-stop shop for all your construction and repair needs! We needed to complete plumbing and electric items and it was so nice to be able to work with just one company to get everything on our list done.
If you want the job done right, this is the team to call!

reviews.text:
Hard Hat Construction is a wonderful company!  They fabricated and installed a mantle on our stone fireplace which looks like it has always been there.  They were very conscientious about making it fit flush with the stones.  We are now using them on additional work at our home.  Can’t speak highly enough about how easy and accommodating Matt Goff and our project manager Joey are wonderful to work with.

2/22/25 — I have always wanted a mantle on our fireplace, but didn’t think it was possible due to the fact that it is made of stones that are irregular shapes. However, after seeing a picture of a similar stone fireplace with a nice mantle, my husband started looking for someone who could do that. Enter Matt Goff with Hard Hat Construction. He told us it was indeed possible, and voila, we had a beautiful mantle on our fireplace just in time for Christmas. Of course, we didn’t stop there. Hard Hat Construction, under the very able guidance of project manager Joey Blair, has just completed a beautiful job in our kitchen and our guest bathroom. They replaced our old mdf cabinet doors with beautiful shaker style solid wood doors; replaced our dark granite countertops with quartz; painted the kitchen and breakfast area; replaced the sink and faucet; and installed a new  ceiling fan. In the guest bathroom they replaced the countertop with quartz; installed new sinks and faucets; scraped, repaired, and painted the ceiling; installed can lights; and painted the walls and cabinets.

In all the work they did they were meticulous.  Communication was awesome.  They were very respectful of our property, covering the floors and hanging dust barriers to cut down on the spread of dust throughout the house.  We even felt comfortable enough with the company and their employees ability to do the job that we took a two week cruise while they worked on the project.  When the work was completed, Joey came for a walk through.  There were a few issues we were concerned about, and Joey had the workers return to take care of the problems.

We would definitely use Hard Hat Construction in the future for any type of home improvement projects.
reviews.author: Chandra Hough

reviews.text:
I met Matt three yrs ago when he remolded a house next door to me. He let my mother and myself look at the house when they finished the remodel. My childhood house was in desperate need of a new roof. I called his office and his representative call me back and said a technician would be out later that afternoon. Eduardo, showed up, ready to take pictures to send to Matt. I spoke with Matt, after Eduardo inspected the roof. I received a quote  the very next day. I had many questions and spoke to Matt for a week before I signed the contract. After I signed the contract, Matt called me with-in the hour. His crew showed up on time, worked all day, and cleaned up before they left. Matt was on site twice, and called to ask me if I was satisfied with his team’s progress. His team finished the job close to 5pm. The quote for the roof was spot on and worked in my favor because I was extremely nervous about the outcome! The roof is beautiful and the house looks great. Matt and his team did a great job restoring a house that will be passed down, from one-generation to the next.
If you are looking for a construction company that cares for their clients, these people are the ones to contact. Matt and his team made it a mission, to make sure I was satisfied with their work.

reviews.text:
Hard Hat construction was recommended to me by a co-worker, and I was given Matt’s phone number to call for my father who was looking to have some foundation work done. I had no idea this was a point I would look back on that my life forever changed. I have worked with contractors and construction companies before, all terrible experiences and had very little expectation that this would be any different.

I met Matt at my father’s house for his first walk through and initial quote. He was confident and knowledgeable and clearly experienced in his field with his very astute recommendations/suggestions which I appreciate. Matt started work on my father’s home after repairs and price were agreed upon. His team was punctual and polite and did nice clean work.

Halfway into the repairs on my father’s foundation, my father’s health plummeted. I had to stop Matt’s team, and I was thrown into a caregiver role for my father. We spent months in and out of hospitals, saw every specialist and ran every test and ultimately my father was placed in a memory care facility. What stands out as exceptional during all of this about this contractor I barley knew, is that he (more than most of my family) called me regularly to check in on me and my dad. He did not always get a level headed customer on the other end of the line, there were plenty of calls where I was in the middle of full on emotional breakdowns and this guy still called. Still checked in. Still listened. The effort he put into offering his services if needed and his ear were beyond what most people offered to me, which was and still is a lifeline.

I’ll skip ahead, it has now been 8 months since I first met the speed-talker that is Matt. I was able to have him complete the work on my father’s home so I could sell it and purchase a home that I could bring my father home from the memory care into for continued long term care. After we found a home that would work I had Matt do all of the work in our new home to make it accessible for my father’s wheelchair, added grab bars, convert bathroom to a walk in shower to accommodate his nurses when they come by, put up railing – anything I could think of to make a space that would be happy for my father. Matt completed the work last week, and we could not be more happy with it. His guys, as per usual, got in – got the work done and got out knowing I am trying to bring my dad home as soon as possible. Great humans are hard to find in this world, often non-existent but not the case here. Matt has forever changed my life and has been there with my husband and I as we navigated into caregiving roles and I could not be more grateful. Matt cares so deeply about people and seems to make it a mission to out do expectations. I am normally a very closed off person and do not let people into my life, Matt somehow attached himself like a leach in the very best way. He has made the work I needed done to both properties the least of my worries and anticipated more of my needs than I even knew I had.

Matt is quite frankly the best in my personal opinion, and I am already starting to make my list for the next property I need work done on. I could not imagine my life now without the one and only Matt Goff.

-RBHG
reviews.author: Holly Goodnight
